units.source_text: 战后，金阁安装了最新式的自动火警报警器。

en.t: After the war, the Golden Pavilion was fitted with the latest automatic fire alarm system.

units.source_text: 只要金阁内部达到一定温度，警报就会响遍鹿苑寺办公室的顾道。

en.t: Whenever the inside of the Golden Pavilion reached a certain temperature, the alarm would ring throughout the corridors of the Rokuonji office.

units.source_text: 6月29日晚上，这警报器发生了故障，是向导老人发现的。

en.t: On the evening of June 29, this alarm malfunctioned, and it was the old guide who discovered it.

units.source_text: 赶巧我在厨房，听见了老人在执事宿舍里报告这件事。

en.t: As it happened, I was in the kitchen and heard the old man report the matter in the steward's quarters.

units.source_text: 我仿佛听到了苍天激励我的声音。

en.t: It was as if I heard the voice of heaven urging me on.
